title: Ethyl Eicosapentanoic Acid (Ethyl-EPA) for Treating Major Depression
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to examine the effectiveness of ethyl-eicosapentanoic acid (ethyl-EPA), an omega-3 fatty acid, in treating depression.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Major depressive disorder

Exclusion Criteria:

* Serious comorbid psychiatric disorder
* Unstable medical illness
* Prior use of any omega-3 fatty acid product
